title: CY60002: Adsorption And Catalysis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite : CY20102Adsorption Equilibrium. Green technology. Phase transfer
and reverse phase transfer catalysis, general principles, physical, dynamic and
thermodynamic principles, applications, homogeneous catalysis, energetics,
homogeneous active sites, activation and deactivation, selectivity,
stereochemistry, orbital symmetry and reactivity of transition metal
complexes.Books: Introduction to the principles of Heterogeneous catalysis, by
J. M. Thomas and W. J. Thomas; Fine chemicals through heterogeneous catalysis,
ed by R. A.Sheldon and H. van Bekkem, Wiley-VCH, Weinheim, 2001; Nanostructured
catalysts, ed by S. L. Scott, C. M. Crudden and C. W. Jones, Kluwer Academic,
NY, 2003; Theory of Adsorption and Catalysis, A. Clark; Studies in Surface
Science and Catalysis volumes, Elsevier.
